rows.grounds: compound denoting the Adi-Shaiva priestly lineage
locative adverb referring to that place or context
compound qualifying brahmins as devoted to Shiva

items.question: Which priests are authorized to officiate in the absence of Adi-Shaivas?
premises: Adi-Shaivas may be absent in that context.
Brahmins are present there as possible officiants.
Those brahmins are identified as Shiva-twice-born.
items.inference: In the absence of Adi-Shaivas, Shiva-twice-born brahmins are authorized there.
uncertainties: Whether brāhmāḥ and śiva+dvijāḥ denote the same group or a subset is contextually implied but not explicitly marked.
items.plain_english: In the absence of Adi-Shaivas there, the brahmins who are twice-born devotees of Shiva serve.
